mod-1.title: Academic Textbook & Monograph Writing Training
mod-1.subtitle: Techniques for writing high-value, plagiarism-free manuscripts that meet DIKTI (Directorate General of Higher Education) standards.
mod-1.format: Hybrid (Star-Rated Hotel in Jakarta & Zoom Live Streaming)
mod-1.targetAudience: University lecturers, researchers at BRIN (National Research and Innovation Agency) and research institutes, and postgraduate students (master's/doctoral).
curriculum: House Style Standards and DIKTI BKD (Lecturer Workload Report) Operational Guidelines for Monographs & Course Books
Techniques for Converting Research Reports, Theses, and Dissertations into Substantive Commercial Monograph Manuscripts
Building Academic Arguments, Chapter Concept Maps, and Integrated Thematic Glossaries
Strategies for Passing the Credit Point (KUM) Assessment for Professor and Associate Professor
facilities: Printed CakraNexa House Style Guidebook
UNESCO B5 Monograph Writing Template (.docx)
Official Training Certificate, 32 Lesson Hours (JP), Eligible for KUM Credit Points
CakraNexa Book Publishing Voucher Worth IDR 1,000,000

mod-2.title: Workshop on Publishing in Reputable International Journals
mod-2.subtitle: Strategies for getting published in Scopus- and SINTA 1–2-indexed journals.
mod-2.format: Interactive Online via Zoom HD & Cloud Classroom
mod-2.targetAudience: Lecturers, principal researchers, and doctoral candidates who need an international publication to meet graduation requirements.
curriculum: Analysis of Editorial Criteria for Q1–Q2 Scopus and Web of Science (WoS) Journals
Dissecting an IMRaD Structure (Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion) That Wins Over Reviewers
Techniques for Responding to Reviewer Comments (Drafting a Rebuttal Letter & Response Matrix)
Identifying and Avoiding Predatory Journals, Hijacked Journals, and Paper Mills
facilities: Diagnostic Manuscript Review by Senior Peer Reviewers
Access to the CakraNexa Researcher Community & Mendeley Shared Library
International Workshop Certificate, 32 Lesson Hours (JP)
Submission Support Until the Manuscript Reaches the Under Review Stage

mod-3.title: Research Methodology & Applied Data Analysis Training
mod-3.subtitle: Mastering quantitative and qualitative data analysis tools for scholarly work.
mod-3.duration: 3 Days of Intensive Practicum (24 Training Hours)
mod-3.targetAudience: Social researchers, accounting/management/law lecturers, fiscal policy analysts, and research consultants.
curriculum: Empirical Research Design in Accounting, Taxation, Economic Law, and Business Governance
Quantitative Multivariate Analysis with SmartPLS 4, SPSS 29, and Stata 18
NVivo 14-Assisted Thematic Qualitative Analysis & Bibliometric Mapping (VOSviewer)
Writing a Discussion Chapter That Links Data Findings to the Grand Theory
facilities: Verified Real-World Datasets for Practice Simulations
Practice Software Licenses for the Duration of the Training
Step-by-Step Guide Modules for Quantitative & Qualitative Data Processing
Applied Data Analysis Competency Certificate, 32 Lesson Hours (JP)

mod-4.title: Copyright Governance & Work Licensing Training
mod-4.subtitle: Intellectual property management and legal protection for authors and institutions.
mod-4.targetAudience: Book authors, heads of university LPPM (research and community service institutes), campus publishing managers, and in-house legal counsel.
curriculum: Core Principles of Law No. 28 of 2014 on Copyright in Protecting Academic Works
Simulation and Procedures for Self-Registration via the e-Hakcipta Portal of the Directorate General of Intellectual Property (DJKI), Ministry of Law and Human Rights
Negotiating Publishing License Clauses, Royalty Rights, and Cross-Border Translation Rights
Mitigating Digital Infringement Risks and Policies on the Use of Works for AI Model Training
facilities: Ready-to-Use Copyright License Agreement Template
Hands-on Guidance to Register 1 Work on DJKI e-Hakcipta
Intellectual Property Legal Consultation with the CakraNexa Legal Expert Board
Intellectual Property Governance Competency Certificate, 16 Lesson Hours (JP)

mod-5.title: Digital Teaching Module Development Training
mod-5.subtitle: Developing interactive teaching materials for higher education and training institutions.
mod-5.format: Interactive Online via Zoom & Learning Management System
mod-5.targetAudience: Course lecturers, vocational training instructors, and curriculum development teams.
curriculum: Aligning Teaching Materials with an OBE-Based Semester Learning Plan (RPS)
Designing Interactive Digital Teaching Modules (ePub3 Format, Integrated Multimedia, and SCORM Packages)

Assessment Rubrics for Graduate Learning Outcomes (CPL) Meeting BAN-PT / LAM "Excellent" Accreditation Standards
facilities: RPS Document and Interactive Teaching Material Design Templates

Guide to Converting Conventional Lecture Notes into Interactive E-Modules
Accredited Teaching Material Developer Certificate, 32 Lesson Hours (JP)

Compilation of Selected Tax Court Rulings as Study Material
Lunch & Coffee Breaks at a Star-Rated Hotel (In-Person Participants Only)
Applied Tax Practice Expertise Certificate, 48 Lesson Hours (JP)
